t_advice_summary_textbox.text: thegnomesappearinpairs,orangeandbrown,greenandpink,redandyellowandpurpleandblue.each gnome in a pair will either lead you to a light forest with red basket or a dark forest with a yellow basket.orange, green red and blue to the light forest.brown, pink, yellow and blue to the dark forest.the number of mushrooms in each forest changes.try and remember which forest pays out the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: My advice would be to be consistant with your choices.The red, green, orange and blue gnomes lead to the red basket.The brown, pink, purple and yellow gnomes lead to the yellow basket.pick a colour basket before you start then select the gnomes for that basket.While you will not always score a high number of mushrooms everytime the consistantacy will help you to build up a nice score.
